notes.title: Version Two Dot Zero 2.0 released.
notes.notes:
A complete update on all system of the game.

Rebuild of the terrain and world layout.
Completely revamped the character controller.
Many new achievements added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310539/c21de73658a90493e394c2426c4561d5c7002667.png

Full controller support is now in effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310539/243b7a357f8be9147bf222b2c0001eebe50b98d5.png

Much more nature and wild life added. 
Hint, make sure to find them all.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3 - Seasonal Events added
notes.notes:
With Update 1.3.3 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310539/a6c8ea88a807db5b6ade08022fc1d53e2aecfadc.png
Picture an example of the day/evening cycle during halloween.

Halloween has been added to the hunt.
- New exploration achievements has been added
- Seasonal system build in, and is kicked off with Halloween.
Theme, style and environment will now change depending on season.

Upcoming theme is halloween and is running from the 10th October until the 5th November.


Next Planned Update:

November 2022 (Version 1.4): 
- Winter season will be added.
- New ability being worked on, the ability to dig yourself in and skip time or weather.

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Changes
- Performance workaround for some AMD GPUs.
- Changed environment, weather and added seasons.

Known bugs to be addressed

Known bugs that will be ignored

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 - more info
notes.notes:
V1.2.1 - Patch



BugFixs

 - Eastern part of map, swimming in the air.
 - Fixed camera clipping on some borders.
 - Save/Load setup changed, some computers where not loading the saves.


UI

 - Added backdrop to ingame audio icons, for increased visability.
 - Updated FUR icon, to show fur or no fur when checked.


Graphics

 - LOD Bias adjusted, decreased performanced, increased quality.
 - Adjusted the water to forest transistion on some areas.
 - Player Foilage bending updated.


Gameplay

 - Adjusted waterdepths AGAIN. 



Known bugs, being worked on

- After loading/Saving reset playerprefs load game.
- Saved game not loading
- Save button 1 not saving
- Load button 2,3 not loading

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 - Clouds in the sky
notes.notes:
Small Patch notes:


 - Start screen UI size adjustment
 - Changed loading and unloading of assets to improve performance.
 - Save file instead of using registry
 - Added Steam Cloud save support

notes.title: V1.2 - The water changes everything
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 notes:

New additions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310539/76a65e76c617ccc6f41c57641e14d2675fcd3612.gif


 The player can now swim, allowing passage across water.
 Loading screen added when starting new game.



Changes and Performance updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42310539/72b02dd36609c8ee30c6797ff1d27bc573a85c1c.png

Some of the fenced areas are now open.
Parts of the fence it self has been removed.
Water depths readjusted again.
UI closes after starting new game, not duplicated.
Additional culling and occlusion added to increase performance.
Additional colliders added to control the player.


Please report any bugs or issues on the forum.

notes.title: Update 1.1: The Speedy fox
notes.notes:
Update 1.1:  The Speedy fox

Additions:

 Boost: When touching the fennec fox, player will receive a 5 second speed buff.
 UI: New icon displayed while speed boost is active.
 Additional particle fx added.



Fixed:
[olist]
 PostFX adjustment to optimize performance.
 Terrain glitch fixed where npc animals would fall through the ground
 Additional colliders added one environments to stop clipping.
[/olist]
